d: Apt Resources is seeking an experienced Mechanical Engineer to join our client's team in Dubai. Experience working on villas, warehouses, commercial buildings, or similar projects.

Proven experience in BOQ preparation, cost estimation, and tender submissions.
Proficiency in AutoCAD and relevant HVAC design software.
Familiarity with UAE/GCC standards and local authority regulations.
